description.tr: Zamanında Mısır'da Mâlikî fakîhlerin reisi olup, tarih ve edebde de mahir idi
description.en: The chief of the Mālikī jurists in Egypt in his time, with expertise also in history and literature

transliteration.ar-Latn-x-alalc: Muḥammad b. al-Qāsim b. Shaʿbān, Abū Isḥāq al-Qurṭubī, also called Ibn Shaʿbān, of the descendants of ʿAmmār b. Yāsir

tr: Muhammed b. el-Kâsım b. Şeʿbân, Ebû İshâk el-Kurtubî, İbn Şeʿbân olarak da denilir, ʿAmmâr b. Yâsır'ın neslindendir
ar: محمد بن القاسم بن شعبان، أبو إسحاق، ابن القرطي ، ويقال له ابن شعبان، من نسل عمار بن ياسر

derived_from.edition_or_version: Khayr al-Dīn al-Ziriklī, al-Aʿlām (Beirut: Dār al-ʿIlm li’l-Malāyīn, 8th ed. 2002), 8 vols.
